limitations: Wallet proving, registry preparation and durable application are excluded.

Query counters are cumulative within each worker; median final snapshots are not additive phase timing.
GPU query transforms, transfers and assembly overlap other phase spans.

scope: Five alternating row/gather pairs with one frozen paired binary, public fixture, laptop GPU and fixed resources.
